6368.note_text: Example: Considering a measuring system of liquids other than water, the range of kinematic viscosity of a turbine is a type- specific parameter fixed by the type approval of the turbine. All the manufactured turbines of the same type have the same range of viscosity.

6366.note_text: legally relevant parameter with a value that depends on the type of instrument only. Type-specific parameters are part of the legally relevant software
